M13.01.note: Device sensing/stimulation and electrical versus mechanical response are explained. No verified paced ECG, pulse-generator/lead hardware model or pacing simulation is supplied. Leadless systems remain explicitly acknowledged.

M13.02.note: Device types are identified without recreating source pad placement, currents, thresholds or procedure/programming instructions. No pacing procedure, patient setup or device operation is simulated.

M13.03.note: Approved distinctions between sensing, output, inhibited/asynchronous modes and specific timing rules are retained. Source missed/abnormal-beat shorthand is not used as a universal triggered-mode definition. No device timing engine or settings control is provided.

M13.04.note: Capture is conditional, conventional ventricular pacing often widens QRS, and dual-chamber systems need not show two visible spikes every cycle. Atrial-only pacing requires appropriate tissue/AV conduction; the source permanent-AF/standstill shorthand is not adopted. No paced strip is fabricated.

M13.05.note: CRT/conduction-system pacing are explanatory vocabulary for selected clinical contexts. Spike count/spacing alone does not establish resynchronization. No biventricular activation, dyssynchrony or programming solver is claimed.

M13.06.note: Electrical capture, mechanical capture, undersensing, oversensing and apparent missing output remain distinct and context dependent. No device failure is diagnosed and no setting is selected from spike position.

illustrationPolicy: No paced strip or hardware image is supplied, copied, extracted or generated. All scenes are explicit cards with no unsupported illustration field.

bindings.scope: No pacing hardware/anatomy, generated paced trace, numerical device engine, capture/sensing/output solver, programming/settings or individual risk/treatment inference.
